76. The function f, whose graph is shown above, is defined on the interval -2 ≤ x ≤ 2. Which of the following
statements about f is false?
(A) f is continuous at x = 0.
(B) f is differentiable at x = 0.
(C) f has a critical point at x = 0.
(D) f has an absolute minimum at x = 0.

77. Let f and g be the functions given by f(x) = e* and g(x) = x4. On what intervals is the rate of change
of f(x) greater than the rate of change of g(x) ?
(A) (0.831, 7.384) only
(B）(-∞,0.831) and (7.384,∞)
